'''Jason Winter''' was a Decipher staff member from February 1996 to January 1998.<ref name="jw-0745" /> The card name [[Chief Retwin]] is an [[Anagrams|anagram]] of his name.<ref name="anagrams">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], geocities.ws. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012174750/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Decipher career ==
Winter met Decipher at Gen Con in 1994, where he spent the convention demonstrating the new ''Star Trek'' CCG. He kept in touch with designer [[Tom Braunlich]], and took over answering players' rules questions when Braunlich stepped away from that job.<ref name="jw-0100">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aq_dwh8Ojys&t=60s Inside the Star Wars CCG: Secrets from Decipher], Imperial Remnant, YouTube (23 November 2025), at 01:00. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261023030638/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aq_dwh8Ojys&t=60s Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Inside the Star Wars CCG: Secrets from Decipher (transcript)]].</ref> He was one of three people hired the same day, about the company's 25th to 27th employees. Decipher had grown to about 80 staff by the time he left. Besides the rules questions and the frequently asked questions list, he contributed to design, playtesting and organized play. He ran ''Star Trek'' and occasional ''Star Wars'' tournaments around the country.<ref name="jw-0745">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aq_dwh8Ojys&t=465s Inside the Star Wars CCG: Secrets from Decipher], Imperial Remnant, YouTube (23 November 2025), at 07:45. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261023030549/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aq_dwh8Ojys&t=465s Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Inside the Star Wars CCG: Secrets from Decipher (transcript)]].</ref> After leaving he continued to playtest for Decipher, including on [[Young Jedi]], until he left Virginia around 2002, and he wrote for ''Scrye'' magazine.<ref name="jw-2523">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aq_dwh8Ojys&t=1523s Inside the Star Wars CCG: Secrets from Decipher], Imperial Remnant, YouTube (23 November 2025), at 25:23. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261023050351/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aq_dwh8Ojys&t=1523s Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Inside the Star Wars CCG: Secrets from Decipher (transcript)]].</ref> A Bith musician card in Young Jedi was named after his roleplaying-game character. His anagram name, [[Chief Retwin]], belongs to the officer standing by the door as Vader leaves the Star Destroyer bridge in ''The Empire Strikes Back''.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aq_dwh8Ojys&t=1614s Inside the Star Wars CCG: Secrets from Decipher], Imperial Remnant, YouTube (23 November 2025), at 26:54. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261023031806/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aq_dwh8Ojys&t=1614s Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Inside the Star Wars CCG: Secrets from Decipher (transcript)]].</ref>
